create.name: Sattva
create.bio:
Sattva is a meditation app rooted in the Vedic tradition, built around the teachings of the spiritual teacher Gurudev Sri Sri Ravi Shankar. Where many meditation apps lean on secular mindfulness, Sattva draws on Sanskrit chanting, mantra and classical yogic practice, with recordings voiced by Sanskrit scholars as well as by Gurudev himself, who leads a large share of its guided sessions.

Its library brings together guided meditations of different lengths, starting at about six minutes for newcomers, along with traditional chants, Vedic mantras, devotional and meditative music, and mudra practices that use hand gestures to work with the flow of energy in the body. Listeners can follow curated collections chosen by time of day or mood, or build their own playlists. A built-in timer and tracker logs practice on a calendar, map and charts, and users can set goals, take on challenges and earn milestones. A community side lets friends share playlists and meditate together in group sessions and live video events. Sattva runs on iOS and Android, with a web version for desktop use.

courses.title: Sattva Web App and Subscription
courses.description: The full Sattva library in a browser: guided meditations, Vedic chants and mantras, mudra practices and music, with the practice timer and tracker. Some content is free and the rest sits behind a paid subscription.
